locale.description: BCP 47 code of this translation (used for dates and plural rules)

extDescription.message: Opens JSON, CSV, XML and text exports from chosen sites in a preview and copies them to the clipboard instead of saving to disk.

errSiteWildcard.message: The asterisk can only be at the start of the address, e.g. *.example.com

popupUnsupportedHint.message: The extension only works on http(s) pages.

popupShortcutTitle.message: This shortcut opens the latest export. You can change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

popupNoPermission.message: Without permission for this site the extension can't work.

popupReady.message: Done — the next export will open in a new tab.

popupEnabledReload.message: Enabled. Reload the tab to start capturing.

popupDisabledReload.message: Disabled. Reload the tab to fully remove the script from the page.

optionsIntro.message: On selected sites, exports (JSON, CSV/TSV, XML, text) open in a preview instead of being saved to disk.

optionsSitesHelp.message: The easiest way to enable a site is the extension icon in the toolbar. If an export comes from another domain (e.g. api.example.com), add it here separately. An entry like *.example.com covers the domain and all its subdomains; an exact entry (e.g. app.example.com) takes precedence over it. Under each site, choose which formats to capture — new sites capture JSON only.

optionsNoSites.message: No sites yet. Turn on capturing from the toolbar icon on any site, or add an address above.

optionsAddHintFromPopup.message: Click “Add” to grant permission for this site.

optionsPermissionDenied.message: Permission for this site was not granted.

optionsAlreadyListed.message: This site is already on the list.

optionsAddedOverride.message: Added. This entry takes precedence over $1 and can have its own formats.

optionsAddedReload.message: Done. Reload the tab with this site to start capturing.

optionsLanguageHelp.message: Popup, settings and preview. The extension name and description on the extensions page follow the browser language.

optionsInterceptServer.message: Also capture files downloaded from the server

optionsInterceptServerHelp.message: When the server sends a file in one of the enabled formats as an attachment (Content-Disposition: attachment). The extension pauses the download and fetches the file again with your session. Doesn't work for exports that require a POST request.

viewerCopyAsFileHint.message: Saves the file to Downloads/peekload and copies its path — paste it into e.g. Claude Code

filterPlaceholderJson.message: Search keys and values or enter a path: $$.items[0].id, $$.items[*].name, $$..id (/)

toastNameFailed.message: Couldn't save the name (has the export expired?)

noticeExpired.message: The data for this export has expired (e.g. after restarting the browser). Export it again.

noticeInvalidJson.message: This isn't valid JSON — showing the raw content.

noticeTruncated.message: Showing the first $1. Copying and saving include everything.

noticeTableRows.message: Showing the first $1 rows. Copying and saving include everything.

noticeTableRowsFiltered.message: Showing the first $1 matching rows. Copying and saving include everything.

noticeDiffLines.message: Showing the first $1 lines of the comparison.

diffTooBig.message: The exports are too large to compare in the preview.

diffTooDifferent.message: The exports differ too much to show a readable comparison.

diffIdenticalSorted.message: The exports have identical content (ignoring key order).

popupHistoryEmpty.message: Exports you capture will appear here.

optionsCopySectionHelp.message: What the Copy button puts on the clipboard for each format.

optionsShortcutHelp.message: Opens the latest export from anywhere in the browser.

optionsPrivacy.message: Everything stays in your browser — exports are never sent anywhere.
